start: Profile tab, a member with several finished workouts in the last 3 months

user_sees: Sections 'Sets per muscle group', 'Muscle distribution', 'Main exercises', 'Records'
must_not: An endless loading skeleton
A workout count that differs from History for the same 7 days

steps.action: Pick a range chip within the last 3 months and switch grouping Week / Month
user_sees: The sets chart redraws from a whole week or month
Muscle distribution 'Sets this period against the one before'
must_not: A first bar that is a stub of a part week
Arrows against a period the log only partly covers

user_sees: The exercise page of that exercise
Row said 'Last: <date>' and how many times it was done
must_not: A different exercise opens
An exercise with no name shown

start: Charts page with at least one record

user_sees: The Records page with every best lift
must_not: 'See all' shown when there are no records
Records that differ from the exercise page
A report for an empty month opening as an error

start: Free member (no MettleUp Plus, no gym plan) on Charts

steps.action: Pick a range longer than 3 months
user_sees: A short note that older charts are part of MettleUp Plus, with a way to /plus
must_not: The range switching to older data anyway
Any workout or history hidden or locked

user_sees: The chart still on the range picked before
must_not: The page left on an empty chart

start: A new member who has not finished any workout

user_sees: 'Your charts show here once you finish a workout.'
must_not: A blank page
NaN or 0% figures
An error message

start: Charts page open, then a workout is deleted in History

steps.action: Go to History, delete one workout from this week, come back to Charts
user_sees: Sets per muscle group lower by that workout's sets
must_not: The old count still shown after coming back
A record from the deleted workout still listed

steps.action: Finish a new workout, open Charts again
user_sees: The new workout counted at once
must_not: The new workout counted twice

start: Member of a gym that gives free MettleUp Plus, signed in

steps.action: Open Charts and pick a 1-year range
user_sees: The 1-year chart opens with no Plus note
must_not: The Plus note shown to a gym member whose plan is active
Any figure read from another member's data

steps.action: Look at what the page shows
must_not: Body weight shown as a number on Charts
Chart data sent to the gym without the member's share switch
